owners.docs: README, AGENTS.md, docs/ and content adapter

entries.purpose: FastAPI backend package: app.server:app, agent pipeline (agents.py), LLM chain (llm.py), graph and Octo retrieval, API contracts (contracts.py).
entries.runtime_data: writes cache/, runs/ and .coord/ at the repo root; reads data/ ($GRAPH_DATA_DIR) and Octo. See contracts/storage.json.

entries.purpose: Compatibility shim: `from app.server import app`, so `uvicorn server:app` still works.
ACS coordination: board.py (task board), claim.py (CLI), hotload.py (in-process reload), plus the vendored ACS runtime.
entries.runtime_data: board and events in $ACS_ROOT/.coord/hackathon, OIO logs in $ACS_ROOT/.oio (outside this repo); reads acs/config.json if present

entries.purpose: Seat claims for the four pipeline agents (assignment.json) and its lock; also holds the CGM pin under pins.cgm.
entries.runtime_data: rewritten on every run; the Pro keeps its own runtime copy across deploys
entries.note: Edit only pins by hand; seats belong to app/coord.py.

entries.purpose: Versioned data model for the app's Octo tables (SCHEMA_VERSION, MODELS, validate), the migration runner and the schema lock.
entries.runtime_data: tables tts_clip, tour_step and schema_version in the Octo workspace; see contracts/storage.json
entries.note: Bump SCHEMA_VERSION and add a migration for any change; run python -m schema.lock.

entries.purpose: Numbered SQL migrations (Postgres and SQLite), applied to Octo by deploy/deploy.sh. Never edit a released one.
entries.runtime_data: applied to the Octo workspace, not stored locally

entries.purpose: Current frontend pages (demo, map, dashboard, slides, guide, observability). Deleted at the v3 cutover; the builder owns web/ and chooses its implementation.
Frontend source and build root, owned by the builder. The built output is served by the app and is not committed.
entries.runtime_data: node_modules/, dist/ and releases/ are build output on the app host; see runtime_paths

entries.purpose: pytest suite run by the CI gates job; live and data tests skip unless RUN_LIVE=1 or data/nodes.jsonl exists.
entries.runtime_data: writes runs/, cache/ and .coord/ while running (gitignored or restored)

entries.purpose: Offline issue-triage helpers used by tools/ci_local.sh.

Workflows: ci.yml (gates), automerge.yml (squash auto-merge), deploy.yml (self-hosted Pro deploy); pull_request_template.md and PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/aba.md (PR bodies with the OSS-considered section); dependabot.yml (weekly pip and Actions updates).
The builder's entry point for this workspace: its only script runs the frontend build in web/, which is the source tree. CI and the deploy host build web/ directly.
ruff and mypy settings for the CI gates.
Machine-readable contracts: openapi.json (API, drift-checked), agents/ (one contract per agent role), storage.json (where data lives).
Pro deployment: deploy.sh (health-checked, rolls back), run_app.sh (uvicorn app.server:app), launchd plists and installer.
entries.runtime_data: the live checkout is ~/precedent on the Pro; secrets come from ~/.hack_env there and are never in git

entries.purpose: Lock file: exact pins made by `uv pip compile requirements.in` (command in its header), with a Python 3.9 branch for the Pro and a 3.10+ branch for CI. Installed by CI and by deploy.sh.
Direct Python dependencies, unpinned; requirements.txt is compiled from it.

Developer scripts: run_all.sh, ci_local.sh, the CGM and OIO adoption checks, kokoro/ (local TTS service installer), Arize helpers; pr_policy.py and dep_policy.py (CI glue for the reuse-first and dependency rules).
Arize experiments, evaluators and judge setup scripts.
entries.runtime_data: talks to Arize; arize/fresh_traces.json is a committed record of replayed span ids

entries.purpose: Project docs and hackathon records; docs/README.md says which are current and which are historical.
Product entry page.
Rules for coding agents, including the always-on writing block between the cgm:always-on markers.
entries.note: Do not hand-edit the text between the cgm:always-on markers; it must match the pinned helper.

entries.purpose: This file: every top-level entry, its owner and where its runtime data lives.
Writing and content adapter (pinned helper version, project brief, brand language, visual style, review rubric, asset provenance).
entries.note: The helper is pinned by commit; its source is never copied here.

entries.purpose: Keeps secrets, caches, run logs and data out of git.
Pinned OIO install: issue-log ontology, project extension, install-manifest. Source is never vendored; see docs/continuity/oio-pin.md.
entries.runtime_data: nothing (code only); ACS also writes OIO run logs under $ACS_ROOT/.oio outside this repo
entries.note: Managed by OIO installer; project.json is adopter-owned.

built frontend output served by the app

LLM, Octo, TTS and graph caches

L1 TTS clip cache (SQLite index plus mp3 files); override with TTS_CACHE_DIR
runtime_paths.lives: local disk of the app host

CI checkout of the pinned OIO commit
